## About
Joel's Truck Alignment & Suspension is a family owned and operated shop in Houston, run by owner Joel Tamez. Joel has worked with tires since he was young, helping out in his father's tire shop.
Today the shop focuses on commercial vehicles: front and rear axle alignments, suspension work, kingpins, bushings and a stock of new and used tires. Joel's goal is simple: honest service at affordable prices, and telling you up front when a repair can save you money.
Drivers have given the shop a 4.9 rating across 347 Google reviews. Stop by, or call for an estimate.

## Services
- Commercial truck alignments: Front end, front axle and rear axle alignments for commercial trucks, plus bent axle repairs.
- Heavy duty suspension: Suspension repair and parts, including shocks, torque arms, U-bolts and truck and trailer springs.
- Kingpins and bushings: Kingpin installation along with press bushings and spring bushings.
- New and used tires: A selection of new and used tires for semis and service trucks, with mounting, balancing, rotations and flat repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Walk-ins are welcome, so you can bring your truck by the shop on Beaumont Hwy.

Q: Can I get an estimate?
A: Yes. Call the shop for a free estimate.

Q: ¿Se habla español?
A: Sí, se habla español.
